experiment.sample: Exact300 frozen Experiment4 image/caption instances; annotation-only exclusions; no replacement
experiment.caption_match: Original Karpathy caption ID -> sentence index; exact lexical/punctuation tokens after HTML unescape and Unicode casefold; punctuation whitespace ignored; no fuzzy matching
experiment.target: Union of all explicit valid T+-linked visual boxes; duplicate boxes deduplicated, overlaps counted once; all boxes per phrase retained; notvisual/id0 and phrases without explicit boxes contribute no region
experiment.coordinates: XML and official parser zero-based inclusive endpoints -> half-open pixel edges; clip to raw image; EXIF transform; exact working/raw oriented dimension ratios; no CLIP crop applied to GT
experiment.raster: Pixel centers in continuous half-open boxes; ceil(edge-.5) bounds, clipped to working dimensions
experiment.spatial_attribution: max(phi_region,0)/region_pixel_count per pixel; preserves each positive region contribution and total SHAP mass; same map for Pointing Game and EIB
experiment.pointing: Highest positive density region; lowest region index for tied density; pixel nearest region centroid, row-major y/x for equal distances
experiment.zero_energy: Included as Pointing failure and EIB=0, numerator=denominator=0; explicitly flagged
experiment.area: Contextual positive area only, not localization quality
experiment.differences: CR minus Pointwise throughout; lower positive area is contextual
experiment.no_inference: Reuse original SHAP/SLIC; no CLIP calls, deletion reruns, training, tuning, Grad-ECLIP or subsequent experiments
